description: This Python script functions as a wrapper generator for integrating Xcode projects with Ninja build system, specifically tailored for gyp build configurations. It includes functions to create workspaces, define build targets, and filter/exclude certain targets based on naming patterns and specifications, facilitating efficient project generation and management within complex build environments.

methods.name: _WriteWorkspace(main_gyp, sources_gyp, params)
methods.description: Creates an Xcode workspace file wrapping main and sources GYP files, generating XML workspace data.

methods.name: _TargetFromSpec(old_spec, params)
methods.description: Constructs a fake build target dictionary for Xcode-Ninja integration based on existing specifications.

methods.name: IsValidTargetForWrapper(target_extras, executable_target_pattern, spec)
methods.description: Determines whether a given build target should be included in the Xcode wrapper based on patterns and target type.

methods.name: CreateWrapper(target_list, target_dicts, data, params)
methods.description: Initializes and prepares build targets for integration with Xcode using Ninja as an external builder, including filtering and workspace creation.
